sayaka5.description: Sayaka gains 1 stack of this skill each turn. While Sayaka has at least 6 stacks, she heals 5 health per turn per 20 health she is missing. Sayaka ignores effects that prevent her healing. If Sayaka reaches 10 stacks of this effect, she instantly dies.

saya_coil.name: Saya Coil
saya_coil.description: Saya deals 20 piercing damage to one random enemy at the end of the turn, permanently. This skill causes Universal Energy Conduit, Saya Coil, Spider Mines, and Well-Used Panic Button to cost an additional Lightning Energy.

semiramis1.name: Chains of the First Poisoner
semiramis1.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their Helpful and Strategic skills for 1 turn.

semiramis2.name: Mystical Beast - Hydra
semiramis2.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. Affected enemies can remove this effect by ending their turn while Invulnerable, and if it expires normally, the target is stunned for 1 turn.

semiramis3.name: Arrogant King's Poison
semiramis3.description: Semiramis deals 5 permanent Affliction damage to all enemies. Upon use, all active enemy Shield, Invulnerability, or heal-over-time effects are converted into additional stacks of 5 permanent Affliction damage. This skill Bypasses.

semiramis5.name: Hanging Gardens of Babylon
semiramis5.description: Semiramis begins the game banished for 2 turns. She returns to the game with 25 permanent Shield, and gains 1 random energy.

shadowblade.name: Shadowblade
shadowblade.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy, increased by 10 for each stack of Deepening Shadows on them. This consumes all stacks of Deepening Shadows on the target.

sheele1.name: Extase - Bisector of Creation
sheele1.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to one enemy. If that enemy has Shield, this skill deals 10 more damage. If that enemy has Damage Reduction, this skill deals 5 more damage. Both of these effects can activate.

sheele2.name: Savior Strike
sheele2.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to one enemy and ends all of that enemy's cancellable effects. Can instead be used on an ally to cleanse them of all Harmful effects and make them Invulnerable for 1 turn.

sheele3.name: Trump Card - Blinding Light
sheele3.description: For 2 turns, all enemies are Shattered. During this time, neither of Sheele's allies can be killed.

shinra1.name: Ignition: Shinra
shinra1.description: For one turn, Shinra's damaging skills will cost one less Green energy and apply 5 permanent affliction damage.

shinra2.name: Rapid Kick
shinra2.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

shinra3.name: Tora Hishigi
shinra3.description: Deals 40 damage to one enemy and stuns them for one turn.

shinra4.name: Adolla Burst
shinra4.description: Shinra becomes invulnerable for one turn.

shinra5.name: Hysterical Strength
shinra5.description: When Shinra falls to 40 health for the first time each game, he will permanently become Isolated and Ignition: Shinra will be reapplied to Shinra each time he uses a new Harmful skill.

shiro1.name: Shiro Kick
shiro1.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shiro's other damaging skills will also stun their target's non-strategic skills for 1 turn and deal 10 additional damage.

shiro2.name: Mascot Rush
shiro2.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shiro's other damaging skills will also Silence the target for 1 turn and deal 10 additional damage.

shiro3.name: Shiro Rampage
shiro3.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shiro's other damaging skills will make her ignore stun and silence effects for 2 turns and deal 10 additional damage.

shiro4.name: Ganta Fight Song
shiro4.description: Shiro permanently taunts the enemy team. During this time, Shiro takes 5 additional damage from new skills and she gains one stack of Ganta Fever each turn this skill remains active. Channeled.

shiro5.name: Ganta Fever
shiro5.description: Whenever Shiro uses a damaging skill, she will consume one stack of Ganta Fever to extend that skill's improvement effect for two turns.

snowwhite1.name: Enhanced Strength
snowwhite1.description: Snow White deals 20 damage to one enemy.

snowwhite2.name: Hear Distress
snowwhite2.description: Snow White targets an ally or an enemy for 1 turn. If used on an ally, that ally will gain 25 points of damage reduction and will gain one random energy if a new harmful ability is used on them. If used on an enemy, that enemy will have their first new harmful ability countered, and they will lose one random energy. This skill is invisible until triggered and ignores invulnerability and isolation.

snowwhite3.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
snowwhite3.description: Snow White targets an ally other than herself. For 1 turn, if that ally dies, they instead return to 50 health. This healing cannot be prevented. This effect will not trigger on abilities that kill the user.

snowwhite4.name: Leap
snowwhite4.description: Snow White becomes invulnerable for one turn.

soothing_night.name: Soothing Night
soothing_night.description: For 4 turns, Laria adds a stack of Deepening Shadows to all allied heroes at the end of each turn. During this time, Laria heals each allied hero for each stack of Deepening Shadows on them and Nightwrap will not remove stacks from them. This ability cannot be used while active and will remove Suffocating Night on use.

soul1.name: Scythe Transformation
soul1.description: For 4 turns, another ally wields Soul. During this time, Soul gains 10 Damage Reduction, and the targeted ally deals 5 more non-Affliction damage and has their Red costs changed to Random costs.

soul2.name: Nightmare Wavelength
soul2.description: Deals 30 affliction damage to one enemy and Soul. If an ally is wielding Soul, the damage is split between them.

soul3.name: Nightmare Sonata
soul3.description: For 3 turns, enemies have their strategic skills delayed for 1 turn and Nightmare Wavelength deals 20 more damage.

soul4.name: Consume Soul
soul4.description: Soul heals 50 health and permanently increases the bonus damage effect from Scythe Transformation by 5. Soul must deal 100 damage before each use of this skill.

soul5.name: Partner: Maka
soul5.description: If Maka is alive on Soul's team, Scythe Transformation can only target her and he will begin the game with Maka wielding him.

soul_cleave.name: Soul Cleave
soul_cleave.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies. While enhanced, heals the Black Knight for 10 health.

spider_mines.name: Spider Mines
spider_mines.description: Saya places two Spider Mines on each enemy, causing them to take 10 damage if they use a non-strategic skill, removing a spider mine. This skill is invisible. This skill causes Universal Energy Conduit, Saya Coil, Spider Mines, and Well-Used Panic button to cost an additional Lightning Energy.

squirtle1.name: Skull Bash
squirtle1.description: Squirtle deals 20 damage to one enemy. 'Squirtle's Withdraw' has it's cooldown reduced by 1 turn.

squirtle2.name: Water Gun
squirtle2.description: Squirtle deals 20 damage to one enemy and makes them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill may not be used during 'Withdraw'. This skill's non-damage effect lasts 1 additional turn for every turn it is used consecutively on the same enemy (stacks).

squirtle3.name: Bubblebeam
squirtle3.description: For 3 turns, Squirtle targets all enemies and deals 5 piercing damage and 5 piercing to any enemy that uses a new skill each turn.

squirtle4.name: Withdraw
squirtle4.description: Squirtle ends any active skill he has on the enemy team and ignores damaging effects for 2 turns. While active, 'Skull Bash' and 'Bubble Beam' become alternates.

squirtle5.name: Rapid Spin
squirtle5.description: Squirtle deals 25 damage to all enemies and ignores enemy stun effects for 1 turn. For 1 turn, 'Hydro Pump' costs 1 less random energy and deals 5 less damage for it's duration.

squirtle6.name: Hydro Pump
squirtle6.description: Squirtle deals 15 piercing damage to all enemies for 2 turns. For 1 turn, 'Rapid Spin' costs 1 less random energy and deals 5 less damage.

squirtle7.name: Thug Life
squirtle7.description: Squirtle's skills have their damage increased by 5 as long as he consecutively casts a new skill on an enemy each turn. The increased damage only applies to a skill the turn it is cast.

stone_bone_serum.name: Stone Bone Serum
stone_bone_serum.description: Loads a serum to be applied with Give and Take. If used on an ally, the ally receives 15 DR for 2 turns. If used on an enemy, that enemy is stunned for 1 turn.

suffocating_night.name: Suffocating Night
suffocating_night.description: For 4 turns, Laria adds a stack of Deepening Shadows to all enemy heroes at the end of each turn. During this time, Laria deals true damage to each enemy hero for each stack of Deepening Shadows on them and Nightwrap will not remove stacks from them. This ability cannot be used while active and will remove Soothing Night on use.

tamaki1.name: Nekomata Blaze
tamaki1.description: Tamaki deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for every damage over time effect on them. If the target is affected by Nekomata Cage, this skill Bypasses Invulnerability. Afterwards, causes the enemy to take 5 affliction damage permanently, stacking.

tamaki2.name: Nekomata Cage
tamaki2.description: Tamaki targets one enemy for three turns. During this time, if they use a new harmful skill they will receive 5 affliction damage per turn for the rest of the game.

tamaki3.name: Ignition: Nekomata
tamaki3.description: Tamaki gains 15 permanent Shield and for the next 3 turns, she will ignore enemy non-damage effects and Nekomata Cage will target all enemies. This skill becomes Nekomata Fireball while active.

tamaki4.name: Fearless Defender
tamaki4.description: Tamaki gains 10 points of damage reduction for 1 turn, and reflects all Harmful skills used on another ally to herself.

tamaki5.name: Nekomata Fireball
tamaki5.description: Tamaki deals 30 affliction damage to one target, increased by 5 for every damage over time effect on them. If the target is affected by Nekomata Cage, this skill ignores invulnerability. Afterwards, applies three stacks of 5 permanent affliction damage to the enemy.

tanjiro1.name: Fourth Form: Striking Tide
tanjiro1.description: Tanjiro deals 20 piercing damage to an enemy. Swaps with 'Tenth Form: Constant Flux'.

tanjiro2.name: Third Form: Flowing Dance
tanjiro2.description: Tanjiro deals 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, increased by 1 turn more whenever Tanjiro uses another skill during this skill. During this time, Tanjiro gains 10 points of damage reduction. This skill cannot be used while it is active and swaps with Sxith Form: Whirlpool.

tanjiro3.name: Seventh Form: Drop Ripple Thrust
tanjiro3.description: For 1 turn, Tanjiro targets his team and counters the first Harmful non-Strategic skill used on them. Countered enemies will take 5 more damage from Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin, and it will deal piercing damage to them. This skill is invisible and swaps with Eight Form: Waterfall Basin.

tanjiro4.name: Second Form: Water Wheel
tanjiro4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

tanjiro5.name: Tenth Form: Constant Flux
tanjiro5.description: Tanjiro deals 30 damage to all enemies. This skill will deal 20 additional damage for each dead enemy.

tanjiro6.name: Sixth Form: Whirlpool
tanjiro6.description: For 2 turns, Tanjiro deals 10 damage to all enemies while making his team invulnerable against Energy skills. Swaps with Third Form: Flowing Dance.

tanjiro7.name: Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin
tanjiro7.description: Tanjiro deals 30 damage to all enemies. Swaps with Seventh Form: Drop Ripple Thrust.

tanjiro8.name: Enhanced Smell
tanjiro8.description: At the end of each turn, Tanjiro's first three skills may change to their alternate versions.

tatsumaki1.name: Psychic Shear
tatsumaki1.description: Deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their Harmful skills until the end of Tatsumaki's next turn.

tatsumaki2.name: Psychokinetic Bind
tatsumaki2.description: Applies 20 Nullify to one enemy. If Nullify from Psychokinetic Bind exists on a different enemy, Tatsumaki will slam them together. If there is an enemy between them, this deals damage to them equal to their total Nullify and stuns the enemy for 2 turns. If not, their total Nullify is split between affected enemies and they are both stunned for 1 turn. This removes all Nullify from affected targets and bypasses invulnerability.

tatsumaki3.name: Extreme Psychic Twisting
tatsumaki3.description: Deals 30 damage to all enemies. Stunned enemies have the duration of their stun effects increased by 1 turn. Swaps to Spear of Green Light for 3 turns.

tatsumaki4.name: Tatsumaki Barrier
tatsumaki4.description: Tatsumaki becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. Swaps with City-Wide Barrier for 4 turns.

tatsumaki5.name: Spear of Green Light
tatsumaki5.description: Targets a currently stunned character, dealing 75 damage to them.

tatsumaki6.name: City-Wide Barrier
tatsumaki6.description: Tatsumaki's team becomes invulnerable for 2 turns.

tatsumi1.name: Killing Strike
tatsumi1.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. If that enemy is stunned, they take 5 additional damage. If the target is below 50 health, they take 5 additional damage. Both of these effects can activate.

tatsumi2.name: Incursio
tatsumi2.description: For 3 turns, Tatsumi gains 10 points of Damage Reduction and becomes Invulnerable at the end of any turn where he doesn't use a new skill. During this time, Neuntote is usable, Killing Strike becomes Piercing damage and Tatsumi's skills will Bypass while he is Invulnerable.

tatsumi3.name: Neuntote
tatsumi3.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy, marking them permanently. Skills and effects will consider the marked enemy to be stunned.

tatsumi4.name: Invisibility
tatsumi4.description: Tatsumi becomes invunerable for 1 turn. Can only be used if Tatsumi is invunerable through Incursio's effect.

the_nightmare_rides.name: The Nightmare Rides
the_nightmare_rides.description: For 2 turns, the Black Knight is invulnerable. During this time, Oathbreaker Strike targets all enemies and is always enhanced.

toga1.name: Thirsting Knife
toga1.description: Toga deals 15 piercing damage to target enemy and gains one stack of Twisted Love.

toga2.name: Vacuum Syringe
toga2.description: Toga deals 10 Affliction damage to one enemy for three turns, gaining one stack of Twisted Love each turn.

toga3.name: Killing Spree
toga3.description: Toga deals 30 Piercing damage to one enemy and becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

toga4.name: Twisted Love
toga4.description: For the next 4 turns, if Toga has 2 or more Twisted Love stacks, Killing Spree deals 15 more damage. If she has 4 or more Twisted Love stacks, her skills cost 1 less Random energy. If she has 6 or more, Twisted Love is replaced by Drop Dead for the duration.

toga5.name: Quirk: Transform
toga5.description: Toga starts the game disguised as another character (showing their face picture). This effect will end if she takes damage or uses a skill other than Thirsting Knife.

toga6.name: Drop Dead
toga6.description: Toga stuns all enemies for 1 turn. On the following turn, they take 25 damage.

touka1.name: Ukaku Slam
touka1.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies. Deals 5 additional damage to an enemy affected by 'Crystallized Shards'. This skill deals 20 additional damage and fully stuns for 1 turn during 'Crystallized Ukaku'.

touka2.name: Crystallized Shards
touka2.description: Touka deals 5 piercing damage to all enemies and increases their cooldowns by 1 for 2 turns. This deals 15 additional damage during 'Crystallized Ukaku'.

touka3.name: Crystallized Ukaku
touka3.description: Touka gains 20 Shield, makes her skills single-target, and deals 5 damage to all enemies every turn for 2 turns.

touka4.name: Touka Observation
touka4.description: Touka becomes invulnerable and increases her damage by 5 for 1 turn.

tsunayoshi1.name: X-Burner
tsunayoshi1.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy, and 10 damage to the others.

tsunayoshi2.name: Zero Point Breakthrough
tsunayoshi2.description: For 1 turn, the first enemy to use a new Affliction or Energy skill on Tsuna is countered and stunned for 1 turn. If this move successfully counters an ability, X-Burner will deal 10 additional damage to all targets for 2 turns.

tsunayoshi3.name: Burning Axle
tsunayoshi3.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy, marking them permanently. If that enemy is damaged by X-Burner, they take 10 damage and are stunned for 1 turn, consuming the mark.

unholy_aura.name: UnholyAura
unholy_aura.description: For 2 turns all enemies and allies deal 10 reduced damage. While enhanced, this ability only affects enemies and refunds one G.

universal_energy_conduit.name: Universal Energy Conduit
universal_energy_conduit.description: Saya gives one random teammate Elemental Essence at the end of her turn. This skill causes Universal Energy Conduit, Saya Coil, Spider Mines, and Well-Used Panic button to cost an additional Lightning Energy.

urahara1.name: BindBenihime
urahara1.description: Fully stuns one enemy, makes them unable to become invulnerable, and ignore healing effects for 1 turn. The following turn, this swaps to 'Fire-Play, Benihime'.

urahara2.name: Seal Slaying Penance
urahara2.description: One enemy has their non-affliction damage lowered by 10 until they use a new non-strategic skill. The next time that enemy uses a new non-strategic skill, they will receive 20 damage. This effect stacks and is invisible.

urahara3.name: Suspended Seal Destruction
urahara3.description: Fully stuns an enemy for 1 turn then removes 1 random energy and their helpful effects from them. If their health is at 50 or less, this stuns for 2 turns and removes 2 random energies instead.

urahara4.name: Negation Block
urahara4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

urahara5.name: Fire-Play, Benihime
urahara5.description: Deals 40 affliction damage to the enemy affected by 'Bind, Benihime'.

uraraka2.name: Gravity Plus
uraraka2.description: Every enemy marked by 'Zero Gravity' takes 20 damage and has the cost of their skills increased by 1 random energy until they use a new skill (stacks).

uraraka1.name: Zero Gravity
uraraka1.description: Marks one enemy. The next skill they use will have its damage reduced by 10 and will remove 1 random energy from them. Swaps to 'Gravity Plus' for 1 turn. Stackable. Invisible.

uraraka3.name: Zero Gravity: Comet Shower
uraraka3.description: Grants all enemies a stack of 'Zero Gravity'. Swaps to 'Gravity Plus' for 2 turns.

uraraka4.name: Uraraka Float
uraraka4.description: For 2 turns, Uraraka gains 20 points of Shield and any enemy that uses a new skill on her will have 'Zero Gravity' used on them. During this time, this skill is replaced by 'Gravity Plus'. Invisible.

uryu1.name: Spirit Particle Subjugation
uryu1.description: Uryuu gains 4 Quincy Energy. As long as he has Quincy Energy remaining, this skill will be replaced by 'Quincy Final Kojaku Shot'.

uryu2.name: Kojaku Shot
uryu2.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy that ignores invulnerability. For 1 turn, 'Seele Schneider' costs 1 random energy and Uryuu becomes invulnerable to enemy non-strategic skills. Uses 1 Quincy Energy.

uryu3.name: Seele Schneider
uryu3.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy and removes 1 random energy from them. For 1 turn, 'Quincy Final Kojaku Shot' costs 1 blue 1 random energy. Uses 1 Quincy Energy.

uryu4.name: Uryuu Evasion
uryu4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

uryu5.name: Quincy Final Kojaku Shot
uryu5.description: Deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for each Quincy Energy Uryuu has. This skill uses up all Quincy Energy. Bypasses.

usopp1.name: Smoke Star
usopp1.description: Usopp Blinds target enemy for 3 turns, and a different random enemy for 1 turn. Will not randomly target an enemy already affected by Smoke Star. Bypassing.

usopp2.name: Impact Dial
usopp2.description: For 1 turn, if any enemy uses a new skill on Usopp or target ally, they will be countered and Stunned for 1 turn if they are currently Blinded.

usopp3.name: Lead Star
usopp3.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, then deals 10 damage to all Blinded enemies.

usopp4.name: Gunpowder Star
usopp4.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies. Enemies currently affected by Smoke Star take 5 more damage for each turn left on its duration. This ends Smoke Star on all affected targets, and any damaged enemy will have Smoke Star permanently last one more turn against them.

usopp5.name: Sharpshooter
usopp5.description: Usopp's attacks cannot Miss or be Dodged, and he ignores Blind effects.

vegeta1.name: Ki Blast
vegeta1.description: Deals 5 piercing damage to one enemy and reduces their non-Affliction damage equal to this skill's damage for 1 turn. Gains 5 more damage each turn that Vegeta does not use a damaging skill that resets on this skill's next use (stacks).

vegeta2.name: Double Ki Blast
vegeta2.description: Vegeta gains one stack of Ki Blast, then uses Ki Blast on the enemy team.

vegeta3.name: Galick Gun
vegeta3.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill deals 5 additional damage every time it's used. Uncounterable.

vegeta4.name: Energy Charge
vegeta4.description: Vegeta gains 10 points of damage reduction for 1 turn. If he doesn't have a new Harmful skill used on him during this time, he reduces the cost of Galick Gun by 1 Red energy until the next time it's used (stacks).

voice_of_light.name: Voice of Light
voice_of_light.description: Target ally gains 15 shield for 1 turn. If damage is dealt to the shield, Ayana gains Elemental Essence.

well_used_panic_button.name: Well-Used Panic Button
well_used_panic_button.description: Saya gains one lightning energy for each Universal Energy Conduit she has built, deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy for each Saya Coil she has built, and detonates all active Spider Mines, dealing 15 piercing damage per stack. Resets all self-changes to energy costs.

xanxus1.name: Scoppio d'Ira
xanxus1.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy. This skill gains the following bonus effects, corresponding to the effects that have triggered Scars of Wrath: Received a stun effect -> Stuns the targeted enemy for 1 turn. Received Piercing damage -> Deals Piercing damage. Received Affliction damage -> Applies 5 permanent Affliction damage.

xanxus2.name: Martello di Fiamma
xanxus2.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy. This skill gains the following bonus effects, corresponding to the effects that have triggered Scars of Wrath: Been Countered -> Uncounterable. Been reduced below half health -> Deals 20 damage to other enemy targets.

xanxus3.name: Flames of Wrath
xanxus3.description: For 1 turn, Xanxus can trigger Scars of Wrath as though it had not yet been triggered by any effects this game. Invisible.

xanxus4.name: Sky Flame Deflection
xanxus4.description: Makes Xanxus invulnerable for 1 turn. This gains the following bonus effects, corresponding to the effects that have triggered Scars of Wrath: Received Affliction damage -> Heals Xanxus 15 health. Received a Shatter effect -> Gives Xanxus 25 Shield. Received an Isolate effect -> Fully cleanses Xanxus.

xanxus5.name: Scars of Wrath
xanxus5.description: The first time Xanxus receives normal damage, Scoppio d'Ira permanently deals 5 more damage, Martello di Flamma costs 1 less Random energy, and Sky Flame Deflection has 1 less cooldown. The same is true for receiving Piercing damage, receiving Affliction damage, being stunned, being countered, being shattered, being isolated, and being reduced below half health. Xanxus also gains a stack on his 2nd and 4th turns.

yamamoto1.name: Shinotsuku Ame
yamamoto1.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy, and lowers their damage by 10 for 2 turns (refreshes). Yamamoto gains 1 stack of Asari Ugetsu.

yamamoto2.name: Utsuhi Ame
yamamoto2.description: Targets one enemy invisibly for 1 turn. The following turn they take 15 damage that Bypasses Invulnerability and Yamamoto gains 1 stack of Asari Ugetsu. If the target used a skill this turn, they receive 15 additional damage and Yamamoto gains 2 stacks of Asari Ugetsu instead.

yamamoto3.name: Asari Ugetsu
yamamoto3.description: Consumes all stacks of Asari Ugetsu on use, and remains active for one turn plus one per stack consumed. While active, replaces Shinotsuku Ame with Scontro di Rondine and Utsuhi Ame with Beccata di Rondine, and Yamamoto gains 25 Shield.

yamamoto5.name: Scontro di Rondine
yamamoto5.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for each damage reducing effect on them.

yamamoto6.name: Beccata di Rondine
yamamoto6.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to the enemy team and lowers their damage by 5 for 3 turns.

yuno1.name: Wind Blades Shower
yuno1.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to all enemies. If this ability hits all living enemies, Spirit Dive: Sylph has its cost reduced by 1 blue energy until its next use.

yuno2.name: Towering Tornado
yuno2.description: For 2 turns, one enemy will be Shattered and if they use a new harmful skill, they take 5 piercing damage. While this is active, Spirit Dive: Sylph has its cost reduced by 1 blue energy.

yuno3.name: Spirit Dive: Sylph
yuno3.description: For 3 turns, Yuno gains 1 blue energy per turn and gains 10 damage reduction. Replaces Wind Blades Shower with Gale White Bow, Towering Torando with Sylph's Breath, and this skill with Spirit of Zephyr while active.

yuno4.name: Sylph Block
yuno4.description: Yuno becomes invulnerable for one turn.

yuno5.name: Gale White Bow
yuno5.description: Deals 35 piercing damage to all enemies. For each enemy struck, Spirit of Zephyr has its cost reduced by 1 blue energy until its next use.

yuno6.name: Sylph's Breath
yuno6.description: For 2 turns, all enemies will be Shattered and take 10 piercing damage per turn. While this is active, Spirit of Zephyr has its cost reduced by 2 blue energy

yuno7.name: Spirit of Zephyr
yuno7.description: Deals 65 piercing damage to one enemy, Bypassing Invulnerability. If this ability is countered, it will automatically cast itself on the following turn. If this ability kills the target, Spirit Dive: Sylph has its duration increased by 2 turns.

zenitsu1.name: Speed of Thunder
zenitsu1.description: Permanently, 'First Form: Thunderclap and Flash' and 'Thunder Release' will deal 5 additional damage. Until the next time it is used, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash will make Zenitsu invulnerable to non-Strategic skills for 1 turn and this skill cannot be used.

zenitsu2.name: Thunder Release
zenitsu2.description: Permanently, 'First Form: Thunderclap and Flash' and 'Thunder Release' will deal 5 additional damage. Until the next time it is used, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash will permanently make Zenitsu deal 0 piercing damage to any enemy that uses a new non-Strategic skill on him.

zenitsu3.name: First Form: Thunderclap and Flash
zenitsu3.description: Zenitsu deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. If Zenitsu is under the effect of both Speed of Thunder and Thunder Release, he will instead deal 15 piercing damage twice.

zenitsu4.name: Falling Maneuver
zenitsu4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

zoro1.name: Onigiri
zoro1.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy and grants Zoro 10 Shield for 1 turn. Swaps to 'Crab Grab'.

zoro2.name: Master of Swords
zoro2.description: For 1 turn, Zoro will ignore enemy stun effects and his skills will deal 5 additional damage permanently (stacks).

zoro3.name: Three-Sword Style Counter
zoro3.description: Zoro will counter the first enemy skill used on himself and one ally for 1 turn. Invisible.

zoro4.name: Three-Sword Style Parry
zoro4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

zoro5.name: One-Sword Style: Lion Strike
zoro5.description: Deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy and grants Zoro 10 Shield for 1 turn. If the target drops to 15HP or below they will be executed. Bypasses invulnerability. Swaps to 'Onigiri'.

hinata1.name: Gentle Fist Taijutsu
hinata1.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy for 4 turns. During this time, this skill can be used again to deal 5 Piercing damage to the originally targeted enemy.

hinata2.name: Protective Eight Trigrams: 64 Palms
hinata2.description: For 4 turns, Hinata's team gains 5 Damage Reduction. During this time, Hinata will deal 5 Piercing damage to any enemy that uses a new Harmful skill on her team, and this skill can be used for no cost to give an ally 10 Shield.

hinata3.name: Eight Trigrams: Air Palm
hinata3.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and stuns their Harmful skills for 1 turn. This skill costs 1 less Random energy if Hinata is using Gentle Fist Taijutsu, and 1 less Random energy if she is using Protective Eight Trigrams: 64 Palms.

hinata4.name: My Turn To Protect
hinata4.description: Hinata applies a permanent, invisible mark to another ally. If an enemy stuns that ally or lowers their HP below 30, Hinata will permanently taunt that enemy. Afterward, this skill will be permanently replaced by Gentle Step: Twin Lions Fist.

hinata5.name: Gentle Step: Twin Lions Fist
hinata5.description: For the next 4 turns, Hinata will deal 10 damage to any enemy she damages (other than with this effect). During this time, Hinata can use this skill to deal 15 damage to an enemy twice.

ace1.name: Fire Fist
ace1.description: Deals 10 damage and 0 Affliction damage to target enemy.

ace2.name: Firefly
ace2.description: Ace applies 1 stack of Firefly to all enemies. Whenever deals new damage to a marked enemy, Ace will consume those marks to deal 10 damage for each mark consumed.

ace3.name: Flame Emperor
ace3.description: Deals 40 damage to target enemy, and 0 permanent Affliction damage to all enemies. This permanent damage can stack.

ace4.name: Flame Pillar
ace4.description: Ace gains 50% Damage Reduction for 1 turn, and 5 Damage Reduction permanently (stacks).

ace5.name: Flame Commandment
ace5.description: Flat Damage Reduction on Ace increases his new Affliction damage by the same amount.

squalo1.name: Zanna di Squalo
squalo1.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy for 3 turns (Bypasses)

squalo2.name: Scontro di Squalo
squalo2.description: Removes all Nullify from Squalo, all Shield from target enemy, then deals 20 Piercing damage to them.

squalo3.name: Squalo Grande Pioggia
squalo3.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy and permanently Shatters them.

yuji1.name: Divergent Fist
yuji1.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy. The following turn, that enemy takes 5 True damage.

yuji2.name: Combat Awakening
yuji2.description: Divergent Fist will target two enemies at random the next time it is used (the same enemy can be chosen twice). If Yuji is below 50 HP, Divergent Fist also deals True damage instead of normal damage on its initial hit. Using this skill increases Yuji's chance to trigger Black Flash by 25%.

yuji3.name: Consume Finger
yuji3.description: Yuji heals himself for 15 HP, permanently increases the initial damage dealt by Divergent Fist by 5, and permanently increases both the minimum and the current chance for Black Flash to activate by 15%.

yuji4.name: Unusual Fortitude
yuji4.description: Itadori Yuji becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

yuji5.name: Black Flash
yuji5.description: Whenever Yuji deals True damage, he has a 15% chance to deal 15 bonus True damage and stun his target's Harmful skills for 1 turn. This chance increases by 20% each time he deals True damage, and resets to its minimum when it triggers successfully.

nobara1.name: Hammer Swing
nobara1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and permanently increases the damage they take from this skill by 5 (stacks).

nobara2.name: Straw Doll Technique
nobara2.description: Until Nobara dies or this skill is re-used, one enemy is permanently Isolated and receives 10 less healing from all sources. Additionally, Resonance's stuns last 3 turns on an enemy affected by this skill.

nobara3.name: Resonance
nobara3.description: For the next 3 turns, Hammer Swing will stun a random class of skills for 1 turn, chosen randomly from Physical, Mental, Energy, and Affliction. The same class cannot be chosen twice. Swaps to Hairpin while active.

nobara5.name: Hairpin
nobara5.description: Nobara counters the first Harmful skill used by target enemy. Countered enemies are executed if their HP is 30 or less. If the target is affected by Straw Doll Technique, this skill lasts for 2 turns and deals 20 damage instead of executing. Invisible until triggered.

nobara4.name: Embrace Pain
nobara4.description: For 2 turns, Nobara will ignore instant-kill and execute effects. At the end of each of her turns she heals 15 HP and gains 10 Damage Reduction, increased to 30 HP and 20 DR if she is affected by a negative non-damage effect. Usable while stunned.

rob9.name: Neko Neko no Mi, Model: Leopard

sukuna1.name: Malevolent Shrine
sukuna1.description: Sukuna targets all other characters for 4 turns, executing them if their HP falls to 5 or less. This threshold increases by 5 each turn, and whenever a selected character uses a skill on Sukuna. During this time, Cleave and Dismantle damages random enemies 2 additional times.

sukuna2.name: Fire Arrow
sukuna2.description: Deals 35 True damage to target enemy.

sukuna3.name: Cleave and Dismantle
sukuna3.description: Sukuna deals 5 damage to all other characters, and permanently afflicts them with an effect that deals 5 damage each turn. This skill can be used repeatedly; each use adds another stack, and every stack deals its damage separately each turn.

sukuna4.name: Demonic Pact
sukuna4.description: Sukuna deals 10 Affliction damage to the ally marked by Sealed King. For 1 turn, that enemy receives triple effect from Sealed King's damage boost, and they ignore non-damage effects. Only usable while Sukuna is stunned by Sealed King and the marked ally is stunned by a different effect.

sukuna5.name: Sealed King
sukuna5.description: Sukuna is permanently stunned, untargetable, and he permanently marks a random ally at the beginning of the game, increasing their non-Affliction damage by 5. Each game, the first time the marked ally's HP falls below 70/30, Sukuna will disable Sealed King on himself and apply it to his ally for 3 turns. If the marked ally dies, Sukuna permanently disables Sealed King.

mami1.name: Tiro Concert
mami1.description: Mami permanently marks the enemy team. Whenever a marked enemy uses a skill, they will take 5 damage (stacks).

mami2.name: Ribbon Wrap
mami2.description: Mami isolates target enemy for 1 turn and stuns their Harmful skills. If Mami Soul Gem has at least 3 stacks, this skill swaps to Tiro Finale for 1 turn.

mami3.name: Tiro Assault
mami3.description: Mami targets one enemy for 3 turns. During this time, that enemy will take 5 damage per turn and Mami will counter the first Harmful skill used on each turn. Each time this effect counters a skill, the enemy gains a stack of Tiro Concert and Mami gains a stack of Mami Soul Gem.

mami4.name: Ribbon Show
mami4.description: Mami removes all harmful effects from her team.

mami5.name: Tiro Finale
mami5.description: Mami deals 40 damage to the enemy affected by Ribbon Wrap, increased by 10 for each stack of Tiro Concert on the enemy. Afterwards, all stacks of Tiro Concert are removed from them.

mami6.name: Soul Gem: Mami
mami6.description: Mami permanently ignores stun effects and gains 1 stack of this effect each turn. While she has at least 3 stacks, Tiro Finale can be used. While she has at least 4 stacks, Tiro Concert deals 5 more damage and she gains 1 more stack each turn. When Mami has 6 stacks of this effect, she instantly dies.

muichiro1.name: Third Form: Scattering Mist Splash
muichiro1.description: Muichiro deals 10 damage to the enemy team. If Muichiro has 3 stacks of Third Form, he deals 15 damage instead.

muichiro5.name: Fifth Form: Sea of Clouds and Haze

toph1.name: Stone Pillar
toph1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. After being used, Stone Pillar costs 1 Random until Toph uses a different skill.

hisoka1.name: Card Throw
hisoka1.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, then 5 Piercing damage to a random target for each stack of Card Throw on Hisoka. Gives Hisoka 1 stack of Card Throw. When Hisoka gains his 4th stack of Card Throw, this skill is replaced by Flamboyant Execution for 1 turn.

hisoka2.name: Bungee Gum - Attract
hisoka2.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

hisoka3.name: Texture Surprise
hisoka3.description: Hisoka marks target character for 3 turns. During this time, your opponent will not see any changes made to that character's HP.

hisoka4.name: Bungee Gum - Catch
hisoka4.description: For 1 turn, Hisoka will ignore any Harmful skill used on him (Invisible). Afterward, this skill is replaced by Bungee Gum - Reflect.

hisoka5.name: Bungee Gum - Reflect
hisoka5.description: Hisoka uses any skills that he ignored with Bungee Gum - Catch on target enemy.

hisoka6.name: Flamboyant Execution
hisoka6.description: Hisoka executes target enemy. Can only target the enemy with the lowest current HP.

emiyaarcher1.name: Caladbolg Barrage
emiyaarcher1.description: Deals 10 True damage to target enemy 2 times. During Hawkeye, this skill deals 10 True damage 3 times. This skill counts as 2 skill uses, or 3 during Hawkeye.

emiyaarcher2.name: Hawkeye
emiyaarcher2.description: EMIYA becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. On the following turn, his skills are empowered. This skill's remaining cooldown is decreased by 1 each time any character uses a skill.

emiyaarcher3.name: Twinblade Rush
emiyaarcher3.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy. While Empowered, deals 20 damage and 20 True damage, and counts as 2 skill uses.

emiyaarcher5.name: Grand Caladbolg
emiyaarcher5.description: Once Emiya has used 12 skills, his next Caladbolg Barrage deals 50 True damage to its target and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

marco6.name: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Phoenix

gojo1.name: Lapse: Blue
gojo1.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and ends all Channeled skills being used by that enemy.

gojo2.name: Reversal: Red
gojo2.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 if Gojo used Lapse: Blue last turn.

gojo3.name: Hollow Technique: Purple
gojo3.description: Deals 45 Piercing damage to target enemy and 15 Piercing damage to all other enemies.

gojo4.name: Infinity Barrier
gojo4.description: Gojo becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. This cleanses Gojo of all harmful effects.

gojo5.name: Six Eyes
gojo5.description: Gojo's skills cost 1 less Blue energy for 1 turn after he is damaged. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

uzui1.name: First Form: Roar
uzui1.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy and removes one random energy from them.

uzui2.name: Constant Resounding Slashes
uzui2.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy and gives Uzui 10 Damage Reduction for 1 turn. Next turn, this skill has half effect but costs 1 Random energy.

uzui3.name: String Performance
uzui3.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy 3 times. For 1 turn, the first Harmful Physical skill used on Uzui will be countered.

uzui5.name: The Score
uzui5.description: The first 4 times Uzui uses a skill, he marks a random enemy with The Score with a matching number. Once this effect has been triggered 4 times, Uzui's cooldowns reset and his skills become free and Uncounterable until he attacks an unmarked enemy or a marked enemy out of order.

tsuyu1.name: Tongue Lash
tsuyu1.description: Target enemy receives 15 damage for 2 turns, or target ally ignores non-damage effects for 2 turns.

tsuyu2.name: Great Leap
tsuyu2.description: For 1 turn, Tsuyu will become Invulnerable to non-Strategic skills. If an enemy is currently affected by Tongue Lash, they receive 15 damage and are stunned for 1 turn. If an ally is currently affected by Tongue Lash, they become Invulnerable for 1 turn.

tsuyu3.name: Frog Mucus
tsuyu3.description: Target enemy deals 10 less non-Affliction damage for 2 turns, or target ally gains 10 Damage Reduction for 2 turns.

jesse1.name: Crystal Beasts
jesse1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and gives Jesse 2 stacks of Crystal Beasts. Deals 5 more damage for each stack of Crystal Beasts on Jesse. After, if Jesse has at least 7 stacks of Crystal Beasts, this skill is permanently replaced with Rainbow Dragon.

jesse2.name: Crystal Abundance
jesse2.description: If Jesse has at least 1 stack of Crystal Beasts, deals 10 damage to all enemies. If he has at least 3, deals double damage. If he has at least 5, stuns its targets' Harmful skills for 1 turn. If he has at least 7, deals triple damage.

jesse3.name: Crystal Blessing
jesse3.description: Heals Jesse 15 HP and gives him one stack of Crystal Beasts.

jesse4.name: Crystal Promise
jesse4.description: Jesse consumes 1 stack of Crystal Beasts to become Invulnerable for 1 turn.

jesse5.name: Rainbow Dragon
jesse5.description: Deals 75 Piercing damage to target enemy (Bypasses)

yubel1.name: Sadistic Taunt
yubel1.description: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn (Invisible). During this time, each time Yubel receives a new Harmful skill, Yubel's allies deal 5 more non-Affliction damage for 1 turn.

yubel2.name: Dark Dimension
yubel2.description: Taunts the enemy team for 1 turn, increased by 1 turn on Invulnerable targets (Invisible).

yubel3.name: Terror Incarnate
yubel3.description: If Yubel has 3 or more stacks of Terror Incarnate, she permanently reflects all damage she takes from enemy skills back to the user. Swaps to Ultimate Nightmare when used.

yubel4.name: Malicious Intent
yubel4.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a new skill, they will be Taunted for 1 turn (Invisible).

yubel5.name: Ultimate Nightmare
yubel5.description: For the rest of the game, any damage Yubel takes from enemy skills is reflected to the enemy team. Requires 6 stacks of Terror Incarnate to be used.

yubel6.name: Sealed Nightmare
yubel6.description: Yubel is permanently Isolated. As long as Yubel has targetable allies, she ignores all Harmful non-damage effects. Each time Yubel is the primary target of a Harmful skill, she gains 1 stack of Terror Incarnate.

jaden1.name: Elemental HERO Avian
jaden1.description: Jaden permanently gains 25 Shield. As long as this Shield persists, all enemies deal 5 less non-Affliction damage and this skill is replaced by Elemental HERO Flame Wingman.

jaden2.name: Elemental HERO Burstinatrix
jaden2.description: Jaden permanently gains 25 Shield. As long as this Shield persists, all enemies receive 10 Affliction damage each turn and this skill is replaced by Elemental HERO Rampart Blaster.

jaden3.name: Elemental HERO Clayman
jaden3.description: For 3 turns, Jaden's entire team gains 10 Shield that increases by 5 each turn. This skill is replaced by Elemental HERO Mudballman.

jaden4.name: Elemental HERO Bubbleman
jaden4.description: Jaden permanently gains 25 Shield. As long as this Shield persists, his team will heal 10 HP each turn and this skill is replaced by Elemental HERO Mariner.

jaden5.name: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman
jaden5.description: Only usable if Jaden is currently under the effect of Elemental HERO Avian and Elemental HERO Burstinatrix. Jaden permanently gains 45 Shield. As long as this Shield persists, he deals 35 damage to a random enemy each turn.

jaden6.name: Elemental HERO Rampart Blaster
jaden6.description: Only usable if Jaden is currently under the effect of Elemental HERO Clayman and Elemental HERO Burstinatrix. Jaden permanently gains 45 Shield. As long as this Shield persists, all enemies are Shattered and cannot gain Shield.

jaden7.name: Elemental HERO Mudballman
jaden7.description: Only usable if Jaden is currently under the effect of Elemental HERO Clayman and Elemental HERO Bubbleman. Jaden permanently gains 100 Shield.

jaden8.name: Elemental HERO Mariner
jaden8.description: Only usable if Jaden is currently under the effect of Elemental HERO Avian and Elemental HERO Bubbleman. Jaden permanently gains 45 Shield. As long as this Shield persists, Jaden will cleanse all Harmful effects on his team and heal his team 5 HP each turn.

venus1.name: Venus Love and Beauty Shock
venus1.description: Deals 5 damage to all enemies and Blinds them for 1 turn. Any enemies that are already Blinded are instead Taunted for 1 turn.

venus2.name: Venus Love Me Chain
venus2.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

venus3.name: Crescent Beam Barrage
venus3.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 2 turns. Lasts 1 more turn for each stack of Venus Burning Love consumed by this skill's use. All other enemies are Blinded for the duration.

venus5.name: Venus Burning Love
venus5.description: Venus permanently deals 5 more damage with her next skill each time she receives a Harmful skill (stacks). She gains 2 stacks instead if that enemy is Taunted.

mine1.name: Roman Artillery - Pumpkin
mine1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If Mine's HP is less than 70, this skill deals 10 more damage and its damage becomes Piercing. If Mine's HP is less than 40, this skill's cost is reduced to one Random energy.

mine2.name: High Output Blast Blade
mine2.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. If Mine's HP is less than 60, this skill stuns all enemies' non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. If Mine's HP is less than 30, this skill deals 15 more damage.

mine3.name: Genius Sniper
mine3.description: Mine targets one enemy. For 3 turns, Mine's skills become Uncounterable and Bypassing, and they deal 10 more damage to that enemy.

toudou1.name: Draw Stance
toudou1.description: For 1 turn, this skill will swap to Raikiri. If Touka receives a new Harmful skill during this time, that skill is countered, its user takes 15 damage, and this skill ends.

toudou2.name: Nukiashi
toudou2.description: For 2 turns, Touka's skills become Invisible.

toudou3.name: Raiou
toudou3.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and increases the Cooldown of their skills by 2 for 1 turn.

toudou4.name: Graceful Dodge
toudou4.description: Touka ignores all damage for 1 turn.

toudou5.name: Raikiri
toudou5.description: Deals 45 Piercing damage to target enemy.

chrome1.name: Illusion: Flame Pillar
chrome1.description: Target enemy gains 15 points of Nullify for 1 turn. If this Nullify expires without being broken, the affected enemy receives 25 Affliction damage. While Empowered, this skill affects all enemies.

chrome2.name: Illusion: Snake Bind
chrome2.description: Target enemy gains 25 points of Nullify for 1 turn. If this Nullify expires without being broken, the affected enemy takes 15 Piercing damage and is stunned for 1 turn. While Empowered, this skill costs 1 more Random energy and its effects last an additional turn.

chrome3.name: Rokudo Takeover
chrome3.description: Chrome heals 15 HP and allows Rokudo control of her body, Empowering her other skills for her next 3 turns. If Chrome is at or below 40 HP, this skill has no cost.

chrome4.name: Illusion: Broken Ground
chrome4.description: For 3 turns, all enemies deal 5 less damage. This effect is removed if an affected enemy uses a Harmful skill. While Empowered, is no longer removed when using Harmful skills.

halibel1.name: Ola Blast
halibel1.description: Deals 25 Energy damage to target enemy. Deals 5 additional damage if any ally is currently protected by Aspect of Sacrifice.

halibel2.name: Ola Azul
halibel2.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. If Halibel is below max HP, the target is also Shattered for 1 turn.

halibel3.name: Aspect of Sacrifice
halibel3.description: For 2 turns, another ally takes 50% reduced damage and the remainder is redirected to Halibel. The first time the protected ally is attacked, Halibel gains a permanent stack of Aspect of Sacrifice (+5 damage on Ola Blast / Cascada and Ola Azul / Hirviendo).

halibel5.name: ResurrecciÃ³n: TiburÃ³n
halibel5.description: The first time Halibel's HP falls below 60, she releases her ResurrecciÃ³n. Ola Blast becomes Cascada (AoE), Ola Azul becomes Hirviendo (Piercing + boiling water DOT), Halibel permanently gains 10 damage reduction, and she immediately gains a stack of Aspect of Sacrifice.

halibel6.name: Cascada
halibel6.description: Halibel unleashes a torrent of water, dealing 20 Energy damage to all enemies. Deals 5 additional damage if any ally is currently protected by Aspect of Sacrifice.

halibel7.name: Hirviendo
halibel7.description: Halibel pierces target enemy for 25 Piercing damage and engulfs them in scalding water, dealing 5 Affliction damage per turn for 2 turns. While Halibel is below max HP, the boiling DOT lasts 3 turns instead.

kitara1.name: Slicing Water Waves
kitara1.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy permanently. Each time it deals damage, its damage increases by 5 for the rest of the Channel. Channeled â€” ends if Katara uses another skill or is stunned.

kitara2.name: Ice Deflection
kitara2.description: Reflects all Harmful skills that target one ally back at their caster for 1 turn. Using this skill does not interrupt Channeling.

kitara3.name: Soothing Water
kitara3.description: Heals target ally for 35 HP and removes all damaging Afflictions from them.

todoroki1.name: Heaven-Piercing Ice Wall
todoroki1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and lowers their non-Affliction damage by 5 for 1 turn. Gives Todoroki a stack of Half-Cold and removes a stack of Half-Hot. Lasts 1 more turn for each stack of Half-Cold on Todoroki.

todoroki2.name: Jet Burn
todoroki2.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to target enemy, gives Todoroki a stack of Half-Hot and removes a stack of Half-Cold. Deals 10 more Affliction damage for each stack of Half-Hot on Todoroki.

todoroki3.name: Glacial Prison
todoroki3.description: Todoroki stuns target enemy for 1 turn and deals 15 damage to them per turn. Gives Todoroki a stack of Half-Cold and removes a stack of Half-Hot. Lasts 1 more turn for each stack of Half-Cold on Todoroki.

todoroki4.name: Fire Wall
todoroki4.description: Deals 0 Affliction damage to all enemies and becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill gives Todoroki a stack of Half-Hot and removes .

todoroki5.name: Half-Hot Half-Cold
todoroki5.description: If Todoroki has more than 1 stack of Half-Hot at the end of his turn, he takes 10 Affliction damage for each extra stack. If he has more than 1 stack of Half-Cold, his skills cost 1 more Random energy for each extra stack.

yoh1.name: Amidamaru Over Soul
yoh1.description: For 5 turns, Halo Blade deals double damage and Yoh heals 5 HP each turn, increased to 10 HP if Yoh was not targeted with a Harmful skill last turn.

yoh2.name: Spirit of Sword
yoh2.description: For 4 turns, Yoh ignores all Harmful non-damage effects and Halo Blade will stun its target for 1 turn. If Amidamaru Over Soul is also active, Grand Halo Blade replaces Halo Blade. White Swan Over Soul cannot be used while active.

yoh3.name: White Swan Over Soul
yoh3.description: For 3 turns, damage to Yoh is capped to 20 and Halo Blade now deals 20 damage, stealing up to 20 HP. If Amidamaru Over Soul is also active, The Absence of Ignorance replaces Halo Blade. Spirit of Sword cannot be used while active.

yoh5.name: Grand Halo Blade
yoh5.description: Yoh deals 40 damage to target enemy, or executes them if they are at or below 40 HP.

yoh6.name: The Absence of Ignorance
yoh6.description: Yoh targets 1 enemy. On the following turn, he reduces their current HP by his own current HP. This is not considered damage.

horohoro1.name: Kororo Snowboard
horohoro1.description: For 4 turns, Kororo's skills are replaced by alternates. During this time, if he is Stunned, he ignores that effect and heals 20 HP.

horohoro2.name: Nipopo Punch
horohoro2.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If that enemy is stunned, they take an additional 15 damage and any stuns on them end. If they aren't stunned, they are stunned until the end of Horohoro's next turn.

horohoro3.name: Nipopo Gauntlets
horohoro3.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy for 2 turns. If the target receives any new stun effects while active, this skill lasts an additional turn. Cannot be used while active.

horohoro4.name: Impeccable Power
horohoro4.description: Horohoro becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. For 4 turns, if Horohoro stuns an enemy, he will become Invulnerable for 1 turn and this effect's duration will be reset.

horohoro5.name: Icicle Sword
horohoro5.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and marks them for 2 turns. Horohoro's other Harmful skills will stun marked enemies for 1 turn.

horohoro6.name: Frost That Rouses The Sleeping
horohoro6.description: Horohoro marks all enemies for 2 turns. Horohoro's other Harmful skills will stun marked enemies for 1 turn. During this time, any enemy that uses a Harmful skill will take 15 damage.

horohoro7.name: All-Swallowing Avalanche
horohoro7.description: Deals 40 damage to all currently stunned enemies. On the following turn, Horohoro deals 40 damage to all enemies that weren't initially damaged.

lyserg1.name: Homing Pendulum
lyserg1.description: Deals 20 damage to a random enemy and applies 1 Morphin Mark. Next turn, Lyserg can select the target of this skill.

lyserg2.name: Blind Pendulum
lyserg2.description: Each enemy with at least 1 Morphin Mark is stunned for 1 turn and have 1 mark removed. If there are 3 or more Morphin Marks active, this skill is replaced by Big Ben Wire Frame.

lyserg3.name: Mastema Dolkeen
lyserg3.description: For 3 turns, Lyserg applies 1 Morphin Mark to a random enemy each turn, and to any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on him. During this time, Homing Pendulum is replaced by Halvaya and Big Ben Wire Frame cannot be used.

lyserg4.name: Heavenly Intervention
lyserg4.description: Lyserg permanently targets an ally. If the target takes new damage that would kill them, they instead become Immortal until the end of the turn and Lyserg deals 35 damage to the enemy that is targeting them. This effect can only be used once.

lyserg5.name: Big Ben Wire Frame
lyserg5.description: Lyserg targets 1 enemy. After 2 turns, that enemy takes 20 damage, increased by 20 for each Morphin Mark on them. While this skill is active, the affected enemy will be executed if their HP falls below 10, increased by 10 for each Morphin Mark on them.

lyserg6.name: Halvaya
lyserg6.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies. Lyserg heals equal to the damage dealt to any targets with at least 1 Morphin Mark.

jeanne1.name: Iron Maiden
jeanne1.description: While not active, Jeanne heals 10 HP each turn and cannot be targeted by any character. While active, Jeanne can use her other skills. If Jeanne is the only character alive on her team, this skill is permanently activated.

jeanne2.name: Gibbet
jeanne2.description: Jeanne permanently targets one enemy. While active, that enemy can only target Jeanne or themselves, and cannot be targeted by other characters. This skill is replaced by Skull and Knee Crushers while active.

jeanne3.name: Shamash Judgment
jeanne3.description: For 2 turns, any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on Jeanne receives 20 damage.

jeanne4.name: Shamash's Kiss
jeanne4.description: Jeanne or target ally become Invulnerable for 1 turn. If that ally is dead, they are instead resurrected with 35 HP.

jeanne5.name: Skull and Knee Crushers
jeanne5.description: Deals 25 damage to the enemy affected by Gibbet and increases the cost of their skills by 1 Random energy. If the target has 35 or less HP, this skill is replaced by Guillotine.

jeanne6.name: Guillotine
jeanne6.description: Executes the enemy affected by Gibbet if their HP is 35 or less.

allmight1.name: Texas Smash
allmight1.description: Deals 40 Piercing damage to target enemy. All Might takes 15 Affliction damage.

allmight2.name: United Resolve
allmight2.description: For 1 turn, All Might ignores Harmful non-damage effects and is Immortal. If All Might is under 40 HP, his skills deal 10 more damage on the following turn, increased to 20 if he received new damage during this time.

allmight3.name: United States of Smash
allmight3.description: Deals 60 Piercing damage to target enemy. All Might takes 25 Affliction damage.

allmight4.name: Declare Successor
allmight4.description: Another ally permanently gains One For All, and All Might permanently receives 10 more Affliction damage from his own skills. This skill can only be used once.

allmight5.name: One For All
allmight5.description: The affected ally has their Random costs reduced by 1 and whenever they use a new skill, they receive 10 Affliction damage. If All Might is dead, their colored costs are permanently changed to Random costs.

ladydevimon1.name: Black Wing
ladydevimon1.description: Deals 25 Affliction damage to target enemy.

ladydevimon2.name: Devil Slap
ladydevimon2.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

ladydevimon3.name: Darkness Spear
ladydevimon3.description: Targets 1 enemy and gives them 10 Nullify, decreases non-Affliction damage they deal by 10 for 1 turn, and gives them a stack of Lady's Poison.

ladydevimon5.name: Lady's Poison
ladydevimon5.description: Enemies that target LadyDevimon with Harmful skills take 5 Affliction damage each turn for the rest of the game (stacks)

alphamon1.name: AlphaBlast
alphamon1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Shatters them for 2 turns (refreshes). On your following turn, Digitalize of Soul costs 1 less Random energy.

alphamon2.name: Blade of the Dragon King
alphamon2.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. Any time Damage Reduction, Shield, Nullify, or hostile damage mods affect this skill's damage, it permanently deals more damage proportional to the mitigated damage.

alphamon3.name: Digitalize of Soul
alphamon3.description: Permanently gives Alphamon 15 Shield and all enemies 10 Nullify. Each turn an enemy has Nullify from this skill remaining, Alphamon deals 20 damage to them. Each turn Alphamon has Shield from this skill remaining, he deals 10 damage to all enemies.

alphamon5.name: Alpha inForce
alphamon5.description: If Alphamon's skills are countered, he regains the energy spent on them and heals 15 HP.

pegasus1.name: Toon Assault
pegasus1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy for 2 turns (Bypasses).

pegasus2.name: Relinquished
pegasus2.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they will be countered and Pegasus will gain 30 Shield. As long as Pegasus has this Shield, this skill and the countered skill are unusable.

pegasus3.name: Dark-Eyes Illusionist
pegasus3.description: Marks target enemy for 1 turn (Invisible). If that enemy does not use a new skill during this time, they take 25 damage. If this effect is triggered while Pegasus has Shield from Relinquished, Relinquished will be permanently replaced by Thousand-Eyes Restrict.

pegasus5.name: Thousand-Eyes Restrict
pegasus5.description: Target enemy's Harmful skills are stunned for 4 turns and Pegasus gains 40 Shield. If this skill's Shield is destroyed, this effect will end and this skill will be replaced by Relinquished. Cannot be used while active.

veldora1.name: Imitation Kamehameha
veldora1.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. If Veldora hs 3 or more stacks of Slumbering Dragon, this skill stuns its target for 1 turn.

veldora2.name: Explosive Aura
veldora2.description: Deals 5 damage to all enemies and reduces their non-Affliction damage by 5 for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill will cost 1 Random energy.

veldora3.name: Tempest Fist
veldora3.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If Veldora has 3 or more stacks of Slumbering Dragon, this skill targets all enemies.

veldora5.name: Slumbering Dragon
veldora5.description: Each turn, if Veldora doesn't use a new skill, he heals 5 HP and his next Harmful skill deals 5 more damage (stacks).

mavis1.name: Fairy Law
mavis1.description: Mavis channels for 3 turns. At the end of the 3rd turn, all enemies that are not Invulnerable take 35 damage and are stunned for 1 turn. All allies that are not Isolated heal 25 HP.

mavis2.name: Bestow
mavis2.description: Another ally has their first skill replaced by Fairy Glitter for 2 turns.

mavis3.name: Fairy Sphere
mavis3.description: Mavis's team ignores all damage for 1 turn, ignores Harmful non-damage effects for 2 turns, and gains 25 Shield for 3 turns.

mavis4.name: Fairy Heart
mavis4.description: Mavis gains 15 Shield for 3 turns. During this time, she cannot act and she gains 1 Random energy each turn. While it is active she cannot be targeted by Fairy Star Strategy.

mavis5.name: Fairy Star Strategy
mavis5.description: At the start of each turn, a random ally is marked with Fairy Star Strategy. If they use a new skill, Mavis gains 1 stack and that ally gains a beneficial effect corresponding to the number of stacks Mavis now has: 1 - Gains 10 Shield. 2 - Heals 20 HP. 3 - Permanently deals 10 more non-Affliction damage. 4+ - Skills have no cost on the following turn.

mavis6.name: Fairy Glitter
mavis6.description: Deals 40 True damage to target enemy.

itachi1.name: Crow Clone
itachi1.description: Itachi targets one enemy for 1 turn (Invisible). During this time, if that enemy uses a new skill, Itachi's skills will cost 1 less Random energy for 1 turn. If they target Itachi with that skill, his skills will also cost 1 less White energy for 1 turn. If either effect is triggered, the enemy takes 10 Piercing damage.

itachi2.name: Tsukuyomi
itachi2.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and stuns them for 1 turn. If that enemy was countered by Kotoamatsukami or damaged by Crow Clone last turn, they are instead banished for 1 turn.

itachi3.name: Kotoamatsukami
itachi3.description: Itachi targets an enemy or an ally for 2 turns. If an ally, counters the next Harmful skill used on them. If an enemy, counters the next Harmful skill they use. The target of this skill is invisible.

itachi4.name: Susanoo
itachi4.description: After being used, the first time Itachi's HP is brought below 50, this effect will be triggered (Invisible). Once triggered, Itachi's other skills are permanently replaced by their alternate versions. During this time, he gains 50 Shield, permanently ignores non-damage effects, and takes 10 Affliction damage at the end of each turn.

itachi5.name: Totsuka Blade
itachi5.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy cannot use skills (this is not a stun effect).

itachi6.name: Yata Mirror
itachi6.description: Target ally gains 30 Shield for 1 turn (Invisible). Each time they receive a Harmful skill during this time, Itachi gains 1 Red energy.

itachi7.name: Yasaka Magatama
itachi7.description: Deals 50 Piercing damage to target enemy. If that enemy's skills are currently sealed by Totsuka Blade, this skill deals 20 more damage.

cooler1.name: Death Chaser
cooler1.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy is marked and this skill swaps to Sadistic Tread.

cooler2.name: Supernova
cooler2.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy for 3 turns. Each turn, this damage increases by 10.

cooler3.name: Darkness Eye Laser
cooler3.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy (Bypassing). After damage, caps the target's HP at its current value.

cooler4.name: Nova Chariot
cooler4.description: For 1 turn, Cooler gains 25 Damage Reduction (Invisible). If he receives a new Harmful skill during this time, Death Chaser will deal 10 more damage to that skill's user on the following turn. Usable while Stunned.

cooler5.name: Sadistic Tread
cooler5.description: Deals 25 damage to an enemy marked by Death Chaser and stuns them for 1 turn. Refreshes the duration of the mark and Sadistic Tread's swap effect.

cooler6.name: Cruel Transformation
cooler6.description: Whenever Death Chaser damages a Stunned enemy or drops a target to below 50 HP, or Nova Chariot is successfully triggered, Cooler enters his Final Form for 1 turn. While in this Form, Death Chaser costs 1 less Random energy, Supernova deals its damage instantly, and Cooler cannot be stunned.

kurotsuchi1.name: Ashisogi Jizo
kurotsuchi1.description: Target enemy takes 15 Affliction damage, then 5 Affliction damage for 2 turns. This effect stacks and refreshes, and if it reaches 3 stacks, it becomes permanent.

kurotsuchi2.name: Data Collection
kurotsuchi2.description: For 3 turns, all invisible skills and effects are revealed. During this time, Mayuri's Drug skills are empowered and he gains 1 Random energy each turn.

kurotsuchi3.name: Flesh-Healing Drug
kurotsuchi3.description: Target ally gains 10 Damage Reduction for 3 turns. During this time, they heal 10 HP each turn. While Empowered, this healing happens instantly. Will swap to a random Drug skill each turn.

kurotsuchi4.name: Nikushibuki
kurotsuchi4.description: Permanently, the next time Mayuri would be killed, he is instead Banished for 2 turns and returns at 30 HP. This effect can only trigger once, and after it has, this skill will make him Invulnerable for 1 turn instead.

kurotsuchi5.name: Bankai - Konjiki Ashisogi Jizo
kurotsuchi5.description: Once Mayuri uses 5 skills, he releases his Bankai for 4 turns. During this time, all enemies receive 5 more damage from Affliction skills and effects, and enemy that targets him with a non-Mental skill will take 5 Affliction damage for 2 turns. During this time, Ashisogi Jizo is replaced by Deadly Gas.

kurotsuchi6.name: Deadly Gas
kurotsuchi6.description: All enemies take 5 Affliction damage for 4 turns. During this time, they ignore cleansing and healing effects.

kurotsuchi7.name: Superhuman Drug
kurotsuchi7.description: For 1 turn, target enemy's skills are Delayed by 1 turn. While Empowered, the duration and delay amount are increased to 2 turns. Will swap to a random Drug skill each turn.

kurotsuchi8.name: Postcognition Drug
kurotsuchi8.description: Target enemy has a random skill's active cooldown increased by 1, and then is Paralyzed for 2 turns. While Empowered, the active cooldown increase occurs 3 times. Will swap to a random Drug skill each turn.

cell1.name: Perfected Combat
cell1.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. Deals +5 damage per time Cell has transformed.

cell2.name: Inherited Solar Flare
cell2.description: Target enemy is Stunned and Shattered for 1 turn.

cell3.name: Absorption
cell3.description: Target enemy gains 25 Nullify and receives 15 Affliction damage per turn for 2 turns. If the target has 30 or less HP, they are also Stunned for 1 turn.

cell4.name: Cellular Regeneration
cell4.description: Cell heals 15 HP for 1 turn. This skill lasts an additional turn for each 15 HP Cell is missing.

cell5.name: Genetic Perfection
cell5.description: If an enemy dies under the effect of Absorption or fails to break its Nullify while it's active, Cell transforms. The first time this happens, Inherited Solar Flare is replaced by Rampant Energy Rain. The second time this happens, Rampant Energy Rain is replaced by Inherited Kamehameha and Absorption is replaced by Inherited Death Beam.

cell6.name: Rampant Energy Rain
cell6.description: Each turn, deals 10 damage to 3 random targets. Continues as long as Cell continues to Channel.

cell7.name: Inherited Kamehameha
cell7.description: Deals 40 Piercing damage to target enemy (Bypasses).

cell8.name: Inherited Death Beam
cell8.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy and Isolates them for 1 turn (Bypasses).

rakko1.name: Bleeding Shot
rakko1.description: Deals 15 Bleed damage to target enemy for 3 turns, decreasing by 5 each turn.

rakko2.name: Close-Range Rifle
rakko2.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each Bleed effect on them. If at least one enemy is Shattered by Wave Tracking, this skill has no cost and can only target those Shattered enemies.

rakko3.name: Relentless Hunter
rakko3.description: For the next 4 turns, Rakko is Invulnerable to Strategic skills and any time an enemy uses a new Strategic skill, Rakko will deal 5 Bleed damage to them for 2 turns.

rakko5.name: Wave Tracking
rakko5.description: Any time an enemy is affected by a new Bleed effect, Rakko also Shatters them for the same duration.

uranus1.name: Space Sword Blaster
uranus1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and gives the ally marked with Uranus Lip Rod 10 Shield for 1 turn.

uranus2.name: Intercepting Strike
uranus2.description: Targets an ally for 1 turn. If an enemy uses a Harmful skill on them during this time, that skill will be countered and the attacker takes 25 damage. Cooldown reduced to 1 turn if this targets the ally marked by Uranus Lip Rod.

uranus3.name: World Shaking
uranus3.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, affected enemies receive 5 more damage from the ally marked by Uranus Lip Rod.

uranus4.name: Space Defense
uranus4.description: Uranus or the ally marked by Uranus Lip Rod become Invulnerable for 1 turn.

uranus5.name: Uranus Lip Rod
uranus5.description: At the start of combat, the ally directly below Uranus is permanently marked with Uranus Lip Rod. While marked, that ally gains 5 Damage Reduction.

hibari2.name: Alaudi's Handcuffs
hibari2.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy, Stunning and Isolating them for 1 turn.

hibari3.name: Porcospino Nuvola
hibari3.description: For 3 turns, all enemies take 5 Piercing damage. During this time, any enemy that uses a Harmful skill takes 10 Piercing damage, and Cloud Tonfa has no cooldown.

hibari5.name: Cloud Flames
hibari5.description: Whenever an enemy uses an Invisible skill, Hibari deals 5 permanent Affliction damage to them (stacks).

seventeen1.name: Hell Breaker
seventeen1.description: Deals 15 Affliction damage to target enemy and gives them 1 stack of 5 permanent Affliction damage. Gives 1 additional stack for each random energy this skill costs.

seventeen2.name: Photon Flash
seventeen2.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy (Bypasses). Affects another random target for each random energy this skill costs.

seventeen3.name: Android Assault
seventeen3.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy each turn and increases the cost of their skills by 1 Random energy. Lasts 1 more turn for each random energy this skill costs.

seventeen4.name: Barrier
seventeen4.description: Android 17 gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Grants 10 more Shield and lasts 1 more turn for each random energy this skill costs.

seventeen5.name: Infinite Energy Cycling
seventeen5.description: Each time Android 17 uses a skill costing less than 3 energy, his skills permanently cost 1 more Random energy. When he uses a skill costing 3 or more energy, he gains 1 Random energy and all stacks of this effect are removed.

broly1.name: Gigantic Slam
broly1.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

broly2.name: Eraser Cannon
broly2.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy for 2 turns. During this time, if they use a new Harmful skill, that skill will be countered, they will take 10 damage, and this skill will end.

broly3.name: Explosive Wave
broly3.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies and Shatters them for 2 turns.

broly4.name: Powered Shell Protect
broly4.description: Broly becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and heals 5 HP for each stack of Legendary Super Saiyan on him.

broly5.name: Legendary Super Saiyan
broly5.description: Each time Broly receives a new Harmful skill, he permanently deals 5 more damage, up to a maximum of 4 stacks. Once he has 4, Explosive Wave is permanently replaced with Planet Geyser Wave.

broly6.name: Planet Geyser Wave
broly6.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to all enemies. After use, Broly loses all stacks of Legendary Super Saiyan.

arthur1.name: Violet Flash
arthur1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Consumes any Shield from Plasmantle on Arthur and any Nullify from Nirvana on the target to increase its damage by the same amount.

arthur2.name: Plasmantle
arthur2.description: For 1 turn, if Arthur would be damaged by a Harmful skill, he instead gains Shield equal to the damage he would have taken (Invisible) for 2 turns.

arthur3.name: Nirvana
arthur3.description: Marks target enemy for 1 turn (Invisible). If that enemy would deal new damage, they instead gain Nullify equal to the damage they would have dealt for 1 turn.

arthur4.name: Star Ring
arthur4.description: Permanently, if Arthur's HP falls below 50, he will ignore damage for 1 turn and Violet Flash will change to Moon Splitting Violet Flash.

arthur5.name: Moon Splitting Violet Flash
arthur5.description: Deals 45 Affliction damage to target enemy and executes them if their HP falls below 20. After using this skill, Arthur dies.

levi1.name: Precision Strike
levi1.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy.

levi2.name: ODM Gear Assault
levi2.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy for 2 turns. Levi is invulnerable during the first turn, and afterward Precision Strike costs 1 Random instead of 1 Green for 1 turn.

levi3.name: Humanity's Strongest
levi3.description: Deals 40 Piercing damage to target enemy.

levi5.name: Relentless Captain
levi5.description: Each time Levi kills an enemy, he permanently deals 5 more damage. This stacks.

vessel2.name: Bandage
vessel2.description: Heals target ally for 10 HP for 2 turns.

vessel3.name: Combat Direction
vessel3.description: Target enemy is Shattered for 2 turns and receives 5 more non-Affliction damage during that time.

vessel4.name: Block
vessel4.description: The Vessel becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

vessel5.name: Second Wind
vessel5.description: The Vessel heals itself for 15 HP. (Alternate Vessel skill.)

vessel6.name: Disarm
vessel6.description: Target enemy is stunned for 1 turn. (Alternate Vessel skill.)

toji1.name: Split Soul Katana
toji1.description: Deals 40 Piercing damage to target enemy and stuns their skills that cost Green energy for 2 turns.

toji2.name: Playful Cloud
toji2.description: Deals 15 damage per turn to target enemy for 2 turns. While affected, the target's skills cost 1 more Green energy. Whenever the target uses a Harmful skill on Toji, this skill's duration increases by 1.

toji3.name: Inverted Spear of Heaven
toji3.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to target enemy and applies a permanent stacking mark. If that enemy's HP ever falls below the threshold (15 per stack), from any source, they are executed.

toji4.name: Chain of a Thousand Miles
toji4.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies. For 1 turn, Toji can only be targeted by skills that cost Green energy.

toji5.name: X-Slash
toji5.description: Marks an enemy that Toji has damaged with 3 unique skills. At the end of that enemy's next turn, if Toji is still alive, they are executed. X-Slash replaces Inverted Spear of Heaven once an enemy can be targeted with it.

adam4.name: Eyes of the Lord
adam4.description: Adam becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 1 stack of Eye Strain.

adam5.name: Eye Strain
adam5.description: Whenever an enemy uses a Harmful skill, Adam gains 1 stack of Eye Strain. At 5 stacks, Adam becomes Blinded for 1 turn, loses all stacks, and permanently deals 5 more damage. Adam cannot gain Eye Strain while Blinded.

adam1.name: Divine Power Replication
adam1.description: Adam copies a random non-Strategic skill from target enemy for 2 turns, replacing Divine Power Replication. The copied skill costs 1 random energy. Adam gains 1 stack of Eye Strain.

adam2.name: Divine Counter
adam2.description: For 1 turn, Adam will counter the next Harmful skill used on him and immediately use that same skill on the attacking enemy, then copy it for 2 turns (replacing Divine Counter). Adam gains 1 stack of Eye Strain.

adam3.name: Endure, Humanity!
adam3.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased to 45 if Adam is Blinded. If this skill kills the enemy, all Blind effects are removed from Adam.

impmon1.name: Badaboom
impmon1.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. If this skill is countered, Impmon heals 15 HP.

impmon2.name: Infernal Funnel
impmon2.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to target enemy for 2 turns.

impmon3.name: Warp Digivolve - Beelzemon
impmon3.description: Warp Digivolve to Beelzemon. Only usable at or below 60 HP. For 3 turns, Impmon receives double healing and all of his skills are replaced by Heartbreak Shot.

impmon4.name: Imp Trick
impmon4.description: Impmon becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and the target enemy is Blinded for 1 turn.

impmon5.name: Lord of Gluttony
impmon5.description: Impmon heals for 50% of all damage he deals.

impmon6.name: Heartbreak Shot
impmon6.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. That enemy ignores all healing for 1 turn.

aiohto1.name: Weapon: Pen-Lights
aiohto1.description: Target enemy ignores Shield effects until the end of the turn, then Ai deals 15 Piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, if Ai's allies use a new skill on that enemy, they gain 10 Shield.

aiohto2.name: Now I'm Mad!
aiohto2.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy and Ai gains 1 Random energy for each dead ally on her team. Has its Green cost changed to Random for 2 turns after using Weapon: Pen-Lights. Has its Red cost changed to Random for 2 turns after using Weapon: Gymnastics Ribbon.

aiohto3.name: Weapon: Gymnastics Ribbon
aiohto3.description: For 3 turns, Ai gains 15 damage reduction and if she's affected by a new Harmful skill, the attacker receives 10 Piercing damage and permanently takes 5 more damage from Pen-Light Charges.

aiohto4.name: I KICK IT HOW I WANNA KICK IT

aiohto5.name: Pen-Light Charges
aiohto5.description: Whenever Ai deals damage to an enemy, she also deals 5 Affliction damage. Ai heals for any damage dealt by this passive effect.

aiohto6.name: Achievement: Ai Reset
aiohto6.description: Whenever Ai kills an enemy with Now I'm Mad!, she heals 10 HP, becomes Immortal for 1 turn, and the cooldown on Now I'm Mad! is reset.

jinwoo1.name: Vital Strike
jinwoo1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. The following turn, this skill costs no energy.

jinwoo2.name: Hand of the Monarch
jinwoo2.description: Stuns target enemy's non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. If Shadow Summon is active, it will damage that enemy exclusively until Hand of the Monarch is used again.

jinwoo3.name: Shadow Summon
jinwoo3.description: Jin-woo gains 1 stack of Shadow Summon. Permanently, Jin-woo gains 10 Shield each turn for each stack of Shadow Summon he has (max 10 per stack). If he already has the maximum amount of Shield, he deals 10 damage to a random enemy for each excess stack (prioritizes enemies marked by Hand of the Monarch).

jinwoored1.name: Vital Strike
jinwoored1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. Jin-woo permanently deals +5 damage.

jinwoored2.name: Hand of the Monarch
jinwoored2.description: Deals 5 damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. Jin-woo permanently deals +5 damage.

jinwoored3.name: Summon - Igris
jinwoored3.description: Permanently, Jin-woo deals 5 Piercing damage to any enemy that becomes Invulnerable. This skill is then replaced by Demon King's Longsword.

jinwoored4.name: Vanish
