jinwoored4.description: Jin-woo becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and permanently deals +5 damage.

jinwoored5.name: Demon King's Longsword
jinwoored5.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy. Jin-woo permanently deals +10 damage.

jinwoogreen1.name: Vital Strike
jinwoogreen1.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy. Deals +10 damage if used the turn after Vanish.

jinwoogreen2.name: Hand of the Monarch
jinwoogreen2.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Mental skills for 1 turn.

jinwoogreen3.name: Summon - Beru
jinwoogreen3.description: Permanently, Jin-woo deals 10 Piercing damage to all enemies each turn. This skill is then replaced by Impossible Speed.

jinwoogreen5.name: Impossible Speed
jinwoogreen5.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy (bypasses Invulnerability) and Jin-woo becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

jinwoowhite1.name: Vital Strike
jinwoowhite1.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and heals Jin-woo 15 HP.

jinwoowhite2.name: Hand of the Monarch
jinwoowhite2.description: Stuns target enemy's non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

jinwoowhite3.name: Summon - Tank
jinwoowhite3.description: Jin-woo gains 30 Shield and his team gains 10 permanent Damage Reduction. This skill is then replaced by Grand Challenge.

jinwoowhite4.name: Vanish
jinwoowhite4.description: Target ally becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

jinwoowhite5.name: Grand Challenge
jinwoowhite5.description: Taunts target enemy for 3 turns and all other enemies for 1 turn.

jinwooblue1.name: Vital Strike
jinwooblue1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. The following turn, this skill costs no energy.

jinwooblue3.name: Summon - Tusk
jinwooblue3.description: Permanently, Jin-woo deals 15 Affliction damage to any Stunned or Silenced enemy at the end of each turn. This skill is then replaced by Hymn of Fire.

jinwooblue4.name: Vanish
jinwooblue4.description: Stuns target enemy's Strategic skills for 1 turn and Jin-woo becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

jinwooblue5.name: Hymn of Fire
jinwooblue5.description: Deals 30 Affliction damage to target enemy. If this skill is Countered, its original target is Stunned for 1 turn.

minene1.name: Grenade
minene1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and applies 1 stack of Explosives Detonator, plus a permanent Ticking Trigger that adds 1 more stack each turn until Explosives Detonator is used. This continuous stack addition does not stack. Grenade is replaced by Explosives Detonator for 1 turn.

minene2.name: Landmines
minene2.description: Plants landmines on an ally or Minene for 1 turn. While active, any enemy that hits that ally with a Harmful skill takes 10 Affliction damage and gains a stack of Explosives Detonator. Landmines is replaced by Explosives Detonator for 1 turn.

minene3.name: Master of Disguise
minene3.description: For 1 turn, 50% of the damage Minene takes is redirected to target enemy. If Minene takes no damage during this time, she gains a stack of Escape Diary.

minene4.name: Escape Route
minene4.description: Minene becomes invulnerable to non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. If her health is below 70, she becomes fully invulnerable instead.

minene5.name: Escape Diary
minene5.description: At the start of Minene's turn, she gains a stack of Escape Diary. When Minene would take 20 or more damage, the hit is reduced by 20% for each Escape Diary stack, consuming all stacks; if 4 or more stacks are consumed, Escape Route's cooldown is reset. When Minene dies, every Explosives Detonator charge on the field detonates.

minene6.name: Explosives Detonator
minene6.description: Deals 10 damage to each enemy marked with Explosives Detonator for every stack they carry, then removes the marks. Bypasses invulnerability.

tsubasa1.name: Azure Slash
tsubasa1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If that enemy is affected by One Thousand Tears, they deal 10 less non-Affliction damage for 1 turn.

tsubasa2.name: One Thousand Tears
tsubasa2.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies and deals 10 more damage to them each turn for 3 turns. While affected, any enemy that damages one of Tsubasa's allies is Taunted for 1 turn.

tsubasa3.name: Burning Wrath Whirl
tsubasa3.description: Channeled. Deals 10 Affliction damage to all enemies each turn for 3 turns, and on the first turn also stuns all enemies' non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. On the final turn it replaces this skill with Burning Wrath Blade for 1 turn. Channeling ends early if Tsubasa is stunned or uses another skill (no Blade).

tsubasa5.name: Ame no Habakiri
tsubasa5.description: Permanently, Tsubasa gains 5 Damage Reduction. Each time she uses a skill, she gains 5 additional Damage Reduction until the end of her opponent's next turn.

tsubasa6.name: Burning Wrath Blade
tsubasa6.description: Deals 40 Affliction damage to target enemy and permanently Taunts them.

denji1.name: Rip and Tear
denji1.description: Deals 15 damage and 15 Piercing damage to target enemy. That enemy takes 10 Bleed damage on the following turn.

denji2.name: Reckless Charge
denji2.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy for 2 turns. That enemy takes 10 Bleed damage on the following 2 turns.

denji3.name: Devil Transformation
denji3.description: For the rest of the game, Denji can use his other skills. This skill permanently becomes Ripcord Pull.

denji4.name: Chainsaw Block
denji4.description: Denji ignores damage for 1 turn (Invisible). Any enemy that uses a skill on Denji during this time takes 10 Bleed damage on the following turn.

denji5.name: Blood Consumption
denji5.description: Whenever Denji deals non-Bleed damage to a bleeding enemy, he heals the same amount.

denji6.name: Ripcord Pull
denji6.description: Denji permanently deals 5 more damage with all non-Bleed skills and effects.

power1.name: Blood Knives
power1.description: Deals 20 Bleed damage to target enemy and prevents them from receiving healing for 1 turn.

power2.name: Blood Spear
power2.description: Marks target enemy for 1 turn. During this time, any non-Bleed damage they would take is prevented, then dealt to them as Bleed damage on the following turn.

power3.name: GAHAHA! GUTS!
power3.description: Deals 15 Bleed damage to target enemy, increased by an amount equal to all the Bleed damage effects on the enemy team.

power4.name: Bloodshed
power4.description: Power targets an enemy with a Bleed effect on them. A random ally of theirs receives Bleed damage next turn equal to every instance of Bleed on the targeted enemy.

power5.name: Blood Fiend
power5.description: Whenever an enemy receives Bleed damage, Power heals for half that amount.

frieza1.name: Death Beam
frieza1.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy and gives them 1 stack of Death Beam. This skill deals 5 more damage per stack of Death Beam already on the target. Every 3rd use, this skill is replaced by Death Beam Barrage for 1 turn.

frieza2.name: Nova Strike
frieza2.description: Frieza gains 35 Shield. At the end of his next turn, whatever remains of that Shield is dealt as damage to a random enemy. The Shield this skill grants is reduced by 5 each time it is used.

frieza3.name: Death Ball
frieza3.description: At the end of the following turn, if target enemy is not Invulnerable, they take 35 damage and are stunned for 1 turn.

frieza5.name: Death Beam Barrage
frieza5.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to any enemy with stacks of Death Beam, dealing 5 more damage per stack. Applies 2 more stacks of Death Beam to each enemy hit.

frieza6.name: Last Emperor
frieza6.description: When Frieza dies, he deals 20 damage to any enemy with 4 or more stacks of Death Beam.

yoruichi1.name: Shunko: Gather
yoruichi1.description: Permanently, whenever an enemy uses a new skill, Yoruichi will deal 5 Piercing damage to them and Paralyze their cooldowns for 1 turn. This skill can be used while active to permanently increase its damage by 5 (Maximum of 6 stacks).

yoruichi2.name: Shunko: Raijin Senkei
yoruichi2.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for each stack of Shunko: Gather on Yoruichi.

yoruichi3.name: Black Cat Warrior Princess
yoruichi3.description: For the next 3 turns, Shunko: Gather's damage is increased by 10, and any enemy that triggers it will be Shattered for 1 turn. During this time, this skill is replaced by Fickle Flash.

yoruichi5.name: Fickle Flash
yoruichi5.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, bypassing Invulnerability. If they are Paralyzed, a random one of their skills has its remaining cooldown increased by 1.

fern1.name: Zoltraak Beam
fern1.description: Deals 45 Piercing damage to target enemy. If Mana Control is active, this skill instead deals 10 Piercing damage plus 20 Piercing damage for each energy left in Fern's pool when it executes (after all skills are paid for), consuming all of that energy.

fern2.name: Mana Control
fern2.description: Fern enhances the effects of Zoltraak Beam, Zoltraak Blasts, and Talented Child. This lasts until Mana Control is used again.

fern3.name: Zoltraak Blasts
fern3.description: For 3 turns, Fern deals 10 damage to a random enemy. If Mana Control is active, this skill instead deals 10 Piercing damage to all enemies one time, increased by 5 for each energy left in Fern's pool when it executes (after all skills are paid for), consuming all of that energy.

fern4.name: Protective Barrier
fern4.description: Target ally gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. If the target already has any Shield, this new 20 Shield is permanent instead.

fern5.name: Talented Child
fern5.description: Every 3 colored energy Fern spends, she generates 1 Red or Green energy at random. If Mana Control is active, she instead generates 1 White or Blue energy at random.

stark1.name: To The Rescue
stark1.description: For 1 turn, Stark reflects Harmful skills used on one ally onto himself and is Immortal. Reflecting a skill this way resets Tumble's cooldown.

stark2.name: Axe Smash
stark2.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy.

stark3.name: Cowardice
stark3.description: For 3 turns, Stark's Superhuman Resilience is disabled. During this time he heals 10 HP per turn and redirects up to 20 damage he takes each turn to his allies, split equally.

stark5.name: Superhuman Resilience
stark5.description: Stark redirects up to 20 total damage his allies would take onto himself each turn, shared between everyone hit by the same skill.

stark6.name: Cleaving Light
stark6.description: Replaces Axe Smash whenever there is an enemy at 30 HP or less. Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, or executes them if their HP is 30 or less.

stark7.name: Lightning Strike
stark7.description: Replaces Axe Smash whenever there is a Stunned enemy, taking priority over Cleaving Light. Stuns target enemy for 2 turns, or deals 30 Piercing damage to them if they are already Stunned.

escanor1.name: Rhitta Smash
escanor1.description: Escanor deals 10 damage to target enemy. Deals 5 more damage per stack of Sunshine on Escanor, and if he has at least 4 stacks, also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

escanor2.name: Cruel Sun
escanor2.description: For 4 turns, all enemies take 5 Affliction damage per turn. While Cruel Sun is active, Escanor gains an extra stack of Sunshine whenever he uses a Harmful skill.

escanor3.name: Pride Flare
escanor3.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new Harmful skill on Escanor next turn, he gains 1 stack of Sunshine. Deals 5 more damage for each 2 stacks of Sunshine on Escanor.

escanor4.name: Flame of Pride
escanor4.description: Escanor gains 1 stack of Sunshine, and then for 1 turn he gains 5 Shield per stack of Sunshine he has. If he has at least 5 stacks of Sunshine, he instead becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

escanor5.name: Sunshine
escanor5.description: Escanor gains 1 stack of Sunshine at the end of each turn, up to a maximum of 12. Whenever Escanor gains a stack of Sunshine for any reason, he heals 5 HP.

escanor6.name: Divine Spear: Escanor
escanor6.description: Deals 100 Piercing damage to target enemy. This skill replaces Rhitta Smash whenever Escanor has 12 stacks of Sunshine, and consumes all stacks on use.

hibiki1.name: Amalgam
hibiki1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. For the rest of the turn, any ally that damages that enemy will heal 10 HP.

hibiki2.name: Alchemic Gold
hibiki2.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. For the rest of the turn, any ally that damages that enemy will deal 5 more non-Affliction damage and gain 5 Damage Reduction for 1 turn.

hibiki3.name: Ex-Drive
hibiki3.description: Hibiki gains 25 Shield and, for the rest of the game, Amalgam and Alchemic Gold's bonus effects will last 1 extra turn. This skill cannot be used while active, and using it will remove Berserk Mode.

hibiki4.name: Berserk Mode
hibiki4.description: For the rest of the game, Hibiki will ignore Stuns and Counter effects. During this time, her skills deal 5 more damage and automatically trigger their extra effects on her, but cannot affect allies. This skill cannot be used while active, and using it will remove Ex-Drive.

hibiki5.name: Gungnir
hibiki5.description: Each time Hibiki's team has taken 50 total damage, Hibiki's next Amalgam or Alchemic Gold will strike twice. The third time this happens, Ex-Drive and Berserk Mode become free for the rest of the game.

piccolo1.name: Special Beam Cannon
piccolo1.description: Piccolo begins Channeling, gaining 1 stack of Special Beam Cannon at the end of each turn. He can re-use this skill to deal 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 25 for each stack of Special Beam Cannon on him.

piccolo2.name: Hellzone Grenade
piccolo2.description: Piccolo begins Channeling, placing 1 stack of Hellzone Grenade on all targetable enemies at the end of each turn. He can re-use this skill for 1 Random to deal 10 damage to all enemies for each stack of Hellzone Grenade on them.

piccolo3.name: Regeneration
piccolo3.description: Piccolo begins Channeling, gaining 1 stack of Regeneration at the end of each turn. He can re-use this skill for no cost to heal for half his missing HP + 10 for each stack of Regeneration on him.

piccolo4.name: Energy Deflection
piccolo4.description: Piccolo becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Can be used while Channeling.

piccolo5.name: Namekian Power
piccolo5.description: Whenever Piccolo finishes Channeling, he gains 5 permanent Shield for each turn he spent Channeling and any skill he used goes on cooldown for 1 turn. Whenever his Channeling is interrupted by an enemy, he gains 1 Green energy.

mashburnedead1.name: Big Bang Dash
mashburnedead1.description: For 1 turn, Ballista Knuckle and Hell Fall Knuckle are enhanced and Mash will ignore negative non-damage effects.

mashburnedead2.name: Ballista Knuckle
mashburnedead2.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. While enhanced, will first remove all Shield on that enemy and deal 10 more damage if Shield was removed.

mashburnedead3.name: Hell Fall Knuckle
mashburnedead3.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. While enhanced, will first remove all Shield and Damage Reduction on that enemy and deal 10 more damage if Shield or Damage Reduction was removed (both can occur).

mashburnedead5.name: Muscle Magic
mashburnedead5.description: Mash cannot have energy drained or stolen from him, and cannot have Nullify applied to him.

law1.name: ROOM
law1.description: For the rest of the game, Law can use his other skills and this skill is replaced by Shambles. At the start of each of his turns, a random ally and a random enemy will be marked with ROOM for 1 turn.

law2.name: Amputate
law2.description: Law targets himself, then automatically deals 30 True damage to the enemy marked by ROOM.

law3.name: Surgeon of Death
law3.description: Deals 20 True damage to target enemy or heals target ally 25 HP. Bypasses invulnerability against targets marked by ROOM.

law4.name: Takt
law4.description: All enemies are Blinded for 1 turn (Invisible).

law5.name: Shambles
law5.description: Marks target enemy for 1 turn (Invisible). If that enemy uses a new Helpful skill, it will be redirected to only target the ally currently marked with ROOM. If they use a new Harmful skill, it will be redirected to only target the enemy currently marked with ROOM.

muzan1.name: Blood Gash
muzan1.description: Deals 15 Bleed damage to target enemy, then 5 Bleed damage per turn for 2 turns, or heals target ally 15 HP, then 5 HP per turn for 2 turns.

muzan2.name: Blood Demon Art: Assimilation
muzan2.description: Deals 35 Bleed damage to target enemy, then 5 Bleed damage per turn for 3 turns, or heals target ally 35 HP, then 5 HP per turn for 3 turns.

muzan3.name: Lab Experiment
muzan3.description: Target ally takes 15 Bleed damage and gains 1 Random energy. Increases the damage or healing of Muzan's next Blood Gash or Blood Demon Art: Assimilation by 10 until it is next used (stacks).

muzan5.name: King of Blood
muzan5.description: Whenever Muzan deals Bleed damage or heals an ally, he heals 5 HP. Whenever a character affected by his bleed or heal over time effects uses a skill, those effects increase their durations by 1 turn.

ainz1.name: Hold of Ribs
ainz1.description: Target character is Isolated and Shattered for 1 turn. This skill's duration is increased by 1 for each extra energy it costs. While active, this skill is replaced by Fallen Down.

ainz2.name: Astral Smite
ainz2.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. +5 damage for each time The Goal of all Life is Death has been triggered, and +5 damage for each extra energy this skill costs.

ainz3.name: Gravity Maelstrom
ainz3.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to all enemies and reduces their damage by 5 for 1 turn. Enemies affected by Hold of Ribs are also stunned for 1 turn. Removes 1 energy from the primary target for each extra energy this skill costs.

ainz4.name: Wall of Protection
ainz4.description: Can target Ainz to make him Invulnerable for 1 turn, or another ally to give them 50% damage reduction for 1 turn. This skill's cost cannot be increased.

ainz5.name: The Goal of all Life is Death
ainz5.description: Whenever Ainz is targeted by a negative non-damage effect, he negates it. The first negation each turn increases all his skills' cost by 1 Random energy for 3 turns.

ainz6.name: Fallen Down
ainz6.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 10 if the target is at full HP. +5 damage for each time The Goal of all Life is Death has been triggered.

baki1.name: Whip Strike
baki1.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the target takes damage from this skill, they also take 10 Affliction damage on the following turn. If either hit drops the target to 25 or less HP, their Strategic skills are Stunned for 1 turn.

baki2.name: Light Speed Jab
baki2.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy. If the target takes damage from this skill, they are also Stunned for 1 turn.

baki3.name: Tiger King
baki3.description: Stuns target enemy's Strategic skills for 1 turn. On the following turn, that enemy takes 25 damage. If Baki receives non-Affliction damage before then, that enemy takes no damage and Tiger King's cooldown is set to 1.

baki4.name: Prehistoric Kenpo
baki4.description: Baki becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and counters the first Harmful, non-Strategic skill used on him. Countered enemies take 10 more damage from Baki's skills for 2 turns.

yusuke1.name: Spirit Gun
yusuke1.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and gives Yusuke 1 stack of Spirit Gun. Deals 10 more damage per stack of Spirit Gun. At 2 stacks, this skill is replaced by Mega Spirit Gun. While Empowered, deals Piercing damage.

yusuke2.name: Spirit Fist
yusuke2.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and Silences them until the end of Yusuke's next turn, or drains 1 energy instead if they are already Silenced by this skill. While Empowered, this whole strike happens twice in a row.

yusuke3.name: Spirit Shotgun
yusuke3.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies. Deals 5 more damage per stack of Spirit Gun and 10 more per stack of Mega Spirit Gun on Yusuke. While Empowered, stuns the primary target for 1 turn.

yusuke4.name: Spirit Charge
yusuke4.description: Yusuke gains 35% damage reduction for 1 turn and Empowers his next Harmful skill. He also gains 1 stack of Spirit Gun, or Mega Spirit Gun if it is currently active.

yusuke5.name: Mega Spirit Gun
yusuke5.description: Deals 20 True damage to target enemy and gives Yusuke 1 stack of Mega Spirit Gun (max 1 stack). Deals 20 more damage per stack of Mega Spirit Gun. While Empowered, Bypasses Invulnerability.

arima1.name: Narukami Sword
arima1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and increases the damage of Arima's next Narukami Blast by 5. If this skill cancels an active Narukami Blast, Arima also gains 15 Shield.

arima2.name: Narukami Blast
arima2.description: Arima permanently targets one enemy. Whenever that enemy uses a new skill, Arima destroys their Shield and deals 20 damage to them, increased by 5 per stack of Narukami Charge.

arima3.name: Ixa Parry
arima3.description: Arima becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If this skill cancels an active Ixa Shield, Arima also ignores all harmful skills and effects for 1 turn.

arima4.name: Ixa Shield
arima4.description: Arima ignores all damage from target enemy for 3 turns. If used the turn after Ixa Parry, instead gives Arima's team 75% damage reduction for 2 turns.

arima5.name: SSS Ukaku Quinque
arima5.description: Arima ignores all negative non-damage effects while he is channeling skills. Every 3rd skill he uses causes Owl Slash to replace Narukami Sword for 1 turn. Owl Finisher replaces Ixa Parry while any character on the field is at 15 or less HP.

arima6.name: Owl Slash
arima6.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each skill Arima has used this game. Overkill damage is converted into permanent Shield for Arima.

arima7.name: Owl Finisher
arima7.description: Executes target enemy or other allied character at 15 or less HP. If this executes an ally, Arima gains 2 Red energy.

sesshomaru1.name: Bakusaiga
sesshomaru1.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy and applies Destructive Corrosion to them for 3 turns.

sesshomaru2.name: Poison Claw
sesshomaru2.description: Deals 15 Affliction damage to target enemy, then 10 Affliction damage each turn for 2 turns. If the target is affected by Destructive Corrosion, deals 5 more initial damage.

sesshomaru3.name: Whip of Light
sesshomaru3.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy and Blinds them for 1 turn. Bypasses Invulnerability against enemies affected by Destructive Corrosion.

sesshomaru5.name: Perfect Daiyoukai
sesshomaru5.description: If Sesshomaru receives a Stun, its duration is reduced by 1 turn (minimum 0); this has a 3 turn cooldown. While Sesshomaru is at 50 or less HP, he ignores harmful effects that would reduce his damage.

sesshomaru6.name: Destructive Corrosion
sesshomaru6.description: Affected enemies have incoming healing reduced by 10, and whenever they are healed they take 10 Affliction damage. If an affected enemy's HP falls to 20 or below, they are Executed.
